Flood defences to be rebuilt at Marlow

The scheme replaces a wall that failed twice in five years.

By Alex Doe
09:15, 4 Aug 2026

Work on the Marlow flood wall will begin in October, the Environment Agency said on Tuesday, six months after the second breach in five years.

The rebuilt section will be a metre higher than the one it replaces and will run a further two hundred metres east, towards the boatyard.

Residents of Riverside Way, who were evacuated twice, have asked for the work to be finished before the winter.
